local_coverage.interpretation: Possessing or programmatically parsing the full official catalogue is not treated as observing model outcomes for every catalogue song. Tests may contain synthetic identities and are excluded. Download/feature/score metadata and real audio names were checked.

new_frame_metadata_only.recommended_amendment: Before any prediction, record the failed 200-artist capacity check and choose all 171 eligible artists from fixed archives 08–11, with up to two hash-ordered songs per artist using one fixed seed. Freeze exact IDs, inputs, application source and correction hashes after the amendment. No replacement or extension based on scores.
new_frame_metadata_only.amendment_reason: The initial 200 was a resource bound, not a power-derived minimum. Metadata-only capacity adjustment does not select on model outcomes. This becomes an artist census of the eligible four-shard frame, not a random draw of 200 artists.

remaining_limits: Novelty is relative to documented project track/artist IDs; the old external-exposure question remains unconfirmed, not assumed negative.
Artist aliases/collaborations and encoder pretraining overlap are unknown.
Four-shard, licensed, genre-annotated frame with at most two songs per artist is not a random sample of all music or a streaming catalogue.
Artist-cluster bootstrap describes conditional resampling/superpopulation approximation, not exact finite-frame sampling uncertainty when all 171 eligible artists are included.
Small positive-label counts may yield wide intervals; report them and retain inconclusive or harmful outcomes without changing the sample.
execution_recommendations: Freeze actual released final_heads and fixed score_correction.json before new predictions; no refit, threshold tuning, or recalibration.
Declare macro Brier corrected-minus-raw primary; log loss, per-label outcomes, and tag-decision equivalence secondary.
Retain all sample failures and do not substitute different songs; distinguish partial-MP3 prefix checks from full-file checksum verification.
Verify first-30-second decoding and a historical feature control before processing the fixed new cohort.
Report identical paired cohorts for raw/corrected, per-label support, artist counts, and conditional paired-artist uncertainty.
Record recipe decisions and the 200-to-171 metadata-only amendment before freezing; retain both positive and negative findings.

expected_selection.formula: sha256(seed + "|artist|" + artist_id), then sha256(seed + "|track|" + track_id); first up to two tracks within every one of 171 artists

implementation_and_presample_review.method_review: No scoring/labels enter artist or per-artist hash selection. Official genre tags are used to define outcomes but no label quotas. All 171 frame artists included. Metadata-only amendment documented before selection/audio/predictions. Full exclusion union includes every prior candidate artist.
implementation_and_presample_review.nonblocking_note: sample() currently slices artists[:artist_count] and checks only selected count; a future robustness guard should require candidate artist count equals configured 171 for the stated census. Current frozen-source candidate frame has exactly 171, independently verified, so this does not affect the present selection.
